_what_this_is: The executed search for finerenone-cv, recorded after execution. The protocol registering it was committed, pushed and anchored in a public transparency log BEFORE the first query. Both ends are anchored so two third-party times bracket the operation.

anchor.what_it_proves: The protocol text existed NO LATER THAN this log time, which is set by a third party. It does NOT prove when the commit was made, and it does not prove no earlier or parallel version existed elsewhere.

ordering.reason: The protocol was committed, pushed to the public default branch, and anchored in a public transparency log before the first query was attempted. The earliest query time is used, not the first success. The anchor is the part a stranger can check without us; the commit timestamp alone is author-supplied and forgeable.

databases.IMPORTANT: 100 of 334 were retrieved. The remaining 234 are NOT screened and NOT excluded -- they are UNEXAMINED. Reporting them as excluded would be a substitution.
databases.DEPARTURE_FROM_THE_REGISTERED_STRING: NCBI's returned query_translation DROPPED `"kidney disease"[MeSH Terms]`, which the registered string contains. 'Kidney Disease' is not a MeSH heading, so the term silently contributed nothing. The string was executed exactly as registered; the SERVICE altered it. Recorded as a departure per section 5 rather than reconciled, and the registered string is not edited after the fact to match what ran.

databases.database: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 -- REGISTERED CONDITION QUERY, AND IT MISSED A PIVOTAL TRIAL
databases.query_as_executed: query.intr=finerenone OR BAY 94-8862 OR Kerendia; query.cond=chronic kidney disease AND type 2 diabetes; filter.overallStatus=COMPLETED|TERMINATED|ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING; count_total=true; page_size=100
databases.FINDING_OF_THE_SEARCH_NOT_OF_THE_SCREEN: FIGARO-DKD (NCT02545049) is ABSENT from these 16 results. It is one of the two pivotal trials this review exists to pool, and the registered condition query cannot reach it: FIGARO-DKD registers its condition as 'Diabetic Kidney Disease' ALONE, while its sibling FIDELIO-DKD (NCT02540993) registers 'Chronic Kidney Disease' and was returned. Two trials of the same drug by the same sponsor index their disease differently, and a query naming the condition as the REVIEW frames it reaches only one of them. This is recorded as a property of the search, not corrected out of it.

what_this_record_does_not_establish: NOT that the search was adequate. Embase, CENTRAL, Web of Science and Scopus were not searched, as section 4 of the protocol states.
NOT that the 334 PubMed records were screened. 100 were retrieved; 234 are unexamined.
NOT any effect estimate. No screening decision, extraction or pooling is recorded here.
NOT that the execution timestamps are third-party. They are this lane's clock. Only the two transparency-log entries carry a time set by anyone else.
